verses.text: Ix tak'wi winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
Tato smasanil in yahelal yet' in kusk'olal tik, tz'echtaj t'a yol junok echlab',
tekan ek'to yalil t'a yichanh yarena'il sti' ha' mar, yuj chi' ix in komon alej icha tik.
Ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, ichato ix och ch'apnaj sjul-lab' t'ayin, haxo sveneno'al spukax t'a in niwanil. Toxo ix oymaj tas ay smay t'ayin yuj.
¿Tokwal tz'ok' nok' kaltakte'al b'uru tato ay yanh nok'? ¿Tokwal tz'ok' nok' mam wakax tato ay tas sk'ux nok'?
¿Mach schi'an junok chib'il wa'il tato malaj yatz'amil? ¿Tokwal wach' sloji sakil nok' nholob' tato malaj yatz'amil?
Icha chib'il wa'il malaj yatz'amil, icha chi' tas tzin chi tikne'ik swab'i. Manhxalaj in gana in wa'i.
Komonok tz'el t'a sk'ol Dios yak'an tas tzin k'an t'ay. Komonok syak' tas tzin nib'ej.
Komonok tz'el t'a sk'ol Dios chi' in sataneli, yik tzin lajwi'el t'a junelnhej.
Wach'chom swab' sya'il yuj in yahelal yet' in kusk'olal tik, palta tzin te tzalaji, yujto swak'nhej och sley Dios yipok in k'o'ol, haton Dios Haxonhej Ochi.
Manhxalaj wip swab'i yik swak'an techaj in yahelal tik, ¿tasxom yuj komon pitzan hinto?
¿Tokwal lajan stzatzil in niwanil tik icha k'e'en k'e'en? ¿Tokwal icha stzatzil k'e'en bronce stzatzil in b'ak'chil?
Maxtzak yal in kolan in b'a t'a yol wiko'. Manhxa junok mach skolwaj wet'ok.
Ha junok mach ayoch t'a syahelal, wach'chom manhxa yelk'och Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil t'ay, palta smoj wal tz'ak'ji sniwanil sk'ol yuj heb' swach'k'o'ol.
Palta a ex tik ex wamigo, tonhej ix in he wach' ju'ejeli. Lajan ex icha junok ha' eluma' stup t'a smelemal.
Ayik syak'an nhab' tat tz'aj sat ha' sb'eyi kalan ha' yet' k'e'en che'ew, ma yet' k'e'en sakb'akom.
Ayik tz'ulax k'e'en che'ew chi', stupem ha' eluma' chi', haxo yik tzowaj k'ak' stakji'em ha'.
Ha heb' anima b'eyum, sb'at heb' t'a titak b'e yik sayan ha' heb' yuk'ej, haxo tz'aji, satkanb'at heb' t'a lum takinh lu'um chi', hata' schamkan heb'.
Ha heb' b'eyum anima aj chonhab' Temán yet' heb' aj Sabá, say ha ha' heb' yojtaktaxon b'aj skani,
haxo yik sk'och heb' b'aj aytaxon ha' chi', takinhxo yet'tal ha', toxonhej stakkank'e sk'ol heb'.
Icha chi' heyaj t'ayin a ex tik, yujto ayik tzeyilanoch jantak in yahelal tik, tonhej tzex xiwk'e'i.
Palta a in tik, malaj tas tzin k'an t'ayex. Malaj tumin tzin k'an t'ayex yik tzin kolchaji.
¿Tokwal tzin k'an he kolwal yik tzin kolchaj t'a yol sk'ab' jun ajk'ol t'ayin, ma t'a juntzanh heb' elk'um?
Hak'ek in k'ayb'ub'al, ol in cha wab' t'ayex. Ch'oxek och in mul chi' t'a in sat.
Malaj junok mach spatikanel junok pensar to wach', palta a ex tik, manhxa stzolal tas tzeyak'och t'a wib'anh.
Ha ex tik nab'anhej tzin he tumej, palta eyojtak to a slolonel junok mach ayoch t'a syahelal, ay b'aj malaj jab'ok yelk'ochi.
Ha ex tik, syal eyak'an he suerte t'a yib'anh heb' meb'a' ob'iltak. Syalpax he chonhanel junok eyamigo.
Ochanhek k'elan t'a in sat, tato tonhej swesej.
Aktejek eyalan juntzanh chi' t'a in patik. Komonok tzeyojtakejeli to yel juntzanh swal tik.
Ha he na'ani to esalwum in. Ha he na'ani to manh wojtakok tas yel yet' tas manh yelok.
